text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=embeddings-production severity=P1 — page fired
incident-bot: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/PD-44231 · responder: @sre-oncall
alex: Acked. I'm taking this — joining bridge now. starting triage.
maria: I'll monitor customer comms & status page. on standby.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by alex
alex: Quick triage: eu-west-1 embedder pool started returning 5xx (503 gateway / 502 upstream). Seen after a scale event ~03:00 UTC. Sample from logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:59:58Z] embedder-03 ERROR inference: kvcache-evict: OOM while compacting
[2026-03-17T03:00:01Z] embedder-04 WARN  api: downstream timeout 10s
[2026-03-17T03:00:05Z] embedder-02 ERROR inference: rpc: connection reset by peer
```
alex: Impact looks like ~8-12% request failure rate for eu customers. latency up for some sessions. I'll loop in routing & autoscaler.
aisha: Confirming — CS Slack flagged 3 customers seeing increased 5xxs. Putting incident on status page now: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/PD-44231
dennis: Noted. I'm going to divert new EU inference traffic to fallback us-east pool for low-latency customers. Applying routing change now.
alex: Doing staged routing reweight: command:
```
curl -X POST https://platform-api.local/routing/reweight \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"service":"embeddings-production","weights":{"eu-west-1":0.2,"us-east-1":0.8}}'
```
maria: :thumbsup: will hold on external comms until we confirm mitigation holds.
alex: Also scaling up dedicated eu-large nodes and temporarily disabling aggressive kvcache eviction flag on embedder service. Patch going out:
```
kubectl set env deployment/embedder KVCACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.85 -n inference
kubectl scale deploy embedder --replicas=8 -n inference
```
aisha: Noted. I updated the status page: "Partial degradation — some requests may fail in EU, mitigation in progress". Customer comms channel created.
dennis: Routing change applied. New requests to eu are 70% -> us-east fallback for premium customers via route-policy:eu-fallback.
alex: First status ping: 03:05 UTC — scaled + routing in place, error rate down from ~10% to ~2.1%.
maria: I'm posting to the customer thread: "We're routing traffic to a fallback pool and scaling. We'll update in 15m or sooner." aisha please add any SLA notes.
aisha: Added temporary credit note for affected customers. tagging billing on the customer thread.
alex: Second status ping: 03:10 UTC — errors at 0.5%, latency back to normal for routed traffic. Rolling checks on non-routed EU traffic show tail-end errors but stable.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident status updated by alex — mitigation in progress
alex: Plan: keep routing in place for 1 hour, collect kernel/runtime logs from embedder nodes, disable autoscaler step that triggered the eviction, and open post-incident ticket. If stable after 1h, revert routing gradually.
maria: I'll close the bridge when alex posts final restore. I'm creating ticket IN-1234 for root-cause (kvcache eviction + autoscaler thresholds) and assigning to eng-runtime.
aisha: I'll draft customer impact summary and update status page with final timeline once we confirm restore.
alex: Final status ping: 03:28 UTC — all checks green, error rate ~0.1%, rolling rollback of fallback routing starting now.
alex: Marking incident resolved and will follow up with postmortem notes in ENG-RELEASES channel.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: resolved by alex
maria: Closing bridge. Follow-up: IN-1234 created, owner @eng-runtime. Thanks everyone for quick ops.
aisha: Publishing customer impact summary now. Expected postmortem tomorrow.

[end of thread]
